finding.evidence_kind: source-only conditional filesystem finding; no native reproduction
finding.title: Exact sentinel basename test misses case-alias nested project manifests
finding.source_reason: Both candidate checks require Path(name).name == PROJECT_FILENAME. ProjectConfigurationStore.read constructs root/PROJECT_FILENAME and reads the actual file through native filesystem lookup. On a filesystem accepting filename case aliases, nested LITERATE.PROJECT.JSON can be consumed by the canonical lower-case loader, while the raw complete census retains uppercase spelling and fails the exact basename predicate.
concrete_paths: Catalog preflight: an ordinary exact target such as flavors/local-toolchain contains child/LITERATE.PROJECT.JSON. Target-prefix spelling checks pass because the target itself is exact. The nested-candidate subtree is not added, so that independently loadable candidate is not protected by this candidate rule.

Ownership partition: an unregistered nested uppercase sentinel under otherwise ordinary source or unclaimed namespace does not enter the required independent-project-candidate refusal and may receive ordinary source/unclaimed classification.
required_change: Use a consistent portable casefold/NFC sentinel-basename candidate predicate in both locations. Candidate detection remains a conservative refusal trigger, not a new ownership or registration grant.

Exclude the actual top-level project parent from nested-candidate classification, rather than excluding only literal name == PROJECT_FILENAME. Otherwise a top-level uppercase own-root spelling would incorrectly protect/refuse the whole project.

Preserve independently verified registered-child semantics. Only actual registered roots may supply the existing independent-project exemption; portable basename equivalence alone does not establish a child owner.
Do not weaken separate exact framework file-role validation or infer framework ownership for case aliases merely to change candidate detection.
finding.execution_limit: No tests/probes or repository code execution this turn. Filesystem case-alias applicability and repaired native behavior must be covered by subsequent maintained acceptance; this is not a claim that every filesystem accepts the spelling.

approval_effect: The prior read-only preflight approval is reopened/superseded only for the newly identified nested-candidate assurance. The same candidate-refusal assurance in retained-layout ownership also needs repair. Earlier PHYSICAL001/CLOSING002 fixes and the separate read-only teardown clarification are not invalidated by this finding.

validation.actions: Read the two predicates and canonical loader path construction; verified their hashes and unchanged related reports. No author233-suite result admitted.

limits: No source/test/pin edits, process-control changes, installs, agents, network or external posts; only this immutable addendum written.
Actual publication, overwrite retirement, imported-role/source-partition effects, root/shared/initial/wrapper cells and full-feature/platform/installed/program/release acceptance remain open.
